title: A default preview's empty `variant`
why: The locator contract settles this: **`variant` is always present and may be empty** — `ServeIssueReport.variantFor` returns `""` for a preview id carrying no `__` axes, while every *other* field emptied means the record no longer names one component. Refusing a blank variant here would make every default preview's acceptance inexpressible, which is exactly the class of defect §2's blank-vs-absent rules exist to prevent.
